ok I need to vent for a sec because what the actual hell.

Deb sent me a listing tonight from a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co. theyre selling my switchblade moth as a “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” for $6.50 or 3 for $15. the same moth I drew for my sept 13 flash day. I posted the sheet aug 30 after spending like 3 weekends drawing it at my kitchen table, and that piece got tattooed in the first hour.

and before anybody says well moths are common, yes. I know. this isnt somebody else drawing a moth with a knife. its got the same wing pattern, the same little crack in the blade, they didnt even flip it. its a straight scan of my linework. come on.

I messaged them and told them it was my design, that I have the original drawing and the post from august, and asked them to take it down because I never gave anybody permission to print it. their response was basically “love your work!” followed by moths are a common motif and if I have a registered copyright I can send it through their support form. have a great day!!

like. you love my work enough to sell it apparently???

the part thats really getting me is the person who got that tattoo messaged me tonight thinking I was the one selling stickers of it. and I want to say this clearly: I did not make those stickers, I did not sell the design, and I did not give them permission to use it. I am so sorry you had to see that and wonder. you paid for a one of one and thats what you should have gotten.

when I sell a flash design, it gets tattooed ONE time on ONE person. thats the whole deal. the person who buys it is trusting me with that and I take it seriously. its not just some random drawing floating around for anybody to slap on a water bottle.

I know mistakes happen and people buy things without knowing where the art came from. Im not mad at anyone who bought a sticker not knowing. but I did tell this company and they had a chance to look at it and take it down. instead I got the moths are common speech.

small shops and independent artists dont have lawyer money to chase down every sticker place that lifts our work and these places know it. its exhausting. I spent actual time drawing that thing and somebody else gets to make money off it while the person wearing it has to wonder if I broke my word.

if you have a minute please go report the Knife Moth Vinyl Decal listing on StickerBurrow Co and please dont buy from them. thats it. dont go harass anybody, just report the listing. thank you Deb for sending it to me and thank you to everyone who looks out for artists. rant over.
